title: Figure 3: Probability density of distance to nearest extraterrestrial civilization
description: Bell-shaped curve titled 'DISTANCE OF NEAREST ET_CIVILIZATION', plotting probability density (1/meters, up to 5.63x10^-20) against 'ET_Distance from Earth (light years)' (0-5000). Captioned 'Figure 3. The Probability of Finding the Nearest Extraterrestrial Civilization at the distance r From Earth (in light years)...', noting a mode of 1933 light years, mean of 2670 light years and standard deviation of 1309 light years.
